title: Egyptian Chicken Tagine
description: A traditional Moroccan stew originating from Egypt, made with chicken and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large clay pot or Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add cumin, ginger, garlic, onion, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, salt, and pepper. Stir well.
Cover the pot and cook for 20-25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through.
Garnish with almonds and serve over rice or couscous.
Optional: Serve with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of sumac.
Note: Traditionally, this dish is cooked in a clay tagine pot, which allows for even heat distribution and a delicious crust on the bottom.
If you don't have a tagine pot, a Dutch oven or large clay pot will work just as well.
